name: Feature request

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

How should it work? Which layer does it touch
(domain / application / infrastructure / api)?

## Alternatives considered

What else did you evaluate and why is this better?

## Justification

Every component must justify its existence. Why does this belong in the
core template rather than userland?
